reference.title: The abstract Matroid class: maximum-weight independent sets
reference.locator: max_weight_independent: nonnegative weights and descending-weight greedy independence algorithm
reference.relationship: Implementation reference for the C16 conditional rank separator. Signed weights are shifted by a constant at fixed basis rank; a mandatory independent vector is contracted. Final cut validity uses independently recomputed integer ranks.
reference.comparison_limit: Sage itself was not executed or installed. No paper was acquired, no academic full-text screen or author-posed question is added, and no historical-priority or full-frame conclusion follows.

scope: One targeted official implementation reference; not a broad literature campaign.
